title: GIS - Kartløsninger for innsyn og forvaltning
description: IKTNH skal gjennomføre anbudskonkurranse på GIS – kartløsninger for innsyn og forvaltning. Vi anser alle deltakende kommuner i denne felles anskaffelsen som en felles anbudskonkurranse. Kommunene Alver, Aurland, Austrheim, Austevoll, Etne, Fedje, Gulen, Masfjorden, Modalen, Osterøy, Samnanger, Sveio, Tysnes, Vaksdal og Vindafjord har etablert felles IKT driftsselskap, IKT Nordhordland kommunalt oppgåvefellesskap (IKTNH). Denne forespørselen gjelder i hovedsak: Anskaffelse av GIS Plattform. Det blir åpna for komplett og/eller delleveranse med følgende alternativer: 1. Løsning for GIS som kun omfatter kartløsning for innsyn og temadataforvaltning. 2. Løsning for GIS som kun omfatter kartløsning for forvaltning. Anskaffelsen(e) skal sikre fremtidsrettede løsninger for kommunene i samarbeidet, samt i størst mulig grad bidra til å forenkle, forbedre og digitalisere arbeidsprosesser knyttet til kartløsninger. Tilbudt løsning må være i kontinuerlig utvikling og gi brukerne tilgang til nye versjoner og funksjonalitet. Dette gjelder også i forhold til nasjonale felleskomponenter. Kommunene skal tilbys nye teknologier etter som de blir tilgjengelige og interessante. Funksjonalitet skal være tilgjengelig etter enklest mulig prismodell som ikke begrenser utvikling, og med størst mulig integrasjon mellom ulike tjenester og teknologier. Det stilles også krav til at løsningen og avtalen, på alle relevante områder, skal støtte opp under et stadig tettere samarbeid mellom de ulike kommunene samt eventuelt nye kommuner som blir en del av samarbeidet. Leverandør skal i hele prosessen bidra til kommunenes arbeid for kompetansedeling, opplæring og erfaringsutveksling mellom kommunene. Vi krever at leverandør aktivt bidrar til å oppnå alle våre målsettinger.

title: Ferske bakerivarer
description: Oppdragsgiver inviterer med dette til konkurranse for etablering av avtale for kjøp av ferske bakerivarer som brød, rundstykker, baguetter, hvetebakst o.l. Rammeavtalen omfatter også lettstekte produkter. Rammeavtalen vil også omfatte ferske kaker/konditorvarer til Fredrikstad kommunes virksomhet for mat, vaskeri og praktisk bistand og til Hvaler kommunes kjøkkentjeneste. Rammeavtalen vil også omfatte ferske kaker/konditorvarer for alle bestillinger som krever levering på helg.Rammeavtalens varighet vil være 2 år med opsjon for oppdragsgiver å forlenge avtalen med 1+1 år. Det skal inngås avtale med en leverandør.Fullstendig beskrivelse av leveransen følger av vedleggene til konkurransegrunnlaget.

buyer: Bergen kommune - Etat for bygg og eiendom
title: R0014EBE - Rammeavtale stillastjenester
description: Etat for bygg og eiendom forvalter, drifter, vedlikeholder og utvikler kommunens eiendommer. Eiendomsmassen består av mer enn 1000 bygg på rundt 1,3 millioner kvadratmeter og 5000 ubebygde eiendommer.Nærmere 60 prosent av byggene er skoler, barnehager og sykehjem. De resterende er blant annet kontorbygg, havnebygg, brannstasjoner, parkeringsanlegg og idrettshaller.

title: OG-26-02 Rammeavtale Digitale psykologtjenester - NY KONKURRANSE
description: Bakgrunn og formål Engerdal, Trysil, Os, Røros og Sel kommuner har til hensikt å inngå rammeavtale for digitale psykologtjenester. Anskaffelsen omfatter kjøp av digitale psykologtjenester på følgende områder, listen er ikke uttømmende: • Depresjon • Stress og PTSD • Angst • Søvnforstyrrelser • Ensomhet • Spiseforstyrrelser • Fysiske sykdommer I tillegg vil det være behov for gruppevis veiledning av kommunens helsepersonell knyttet til bl.a. psykisk helse, rus og helsestasjon. Tjenesten skal bidra til at pasienter og brukere får rett hjelp til rett tid, og skal primært omfatte personer over 18 år. Tjenester til personer under 18 år ivaretas i hovedsak gjennom BUP/DPS og helsesykepleier. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å sikre at kommunenes lovpålagte helse- og omsorgstjenester kan leveres på en forsvarlig, tilgjengelig og fleksibel måte, ved at det til enhver tid finnes tilgjengelig og kompetent psykologfaglig personell tilpasset pasientenes og brukernes behov. Det er særdeles viktig at tilbyder disponerer en tilstrekkelig omfattende og robust stillings‑ og ressurs­pool, slik at kommunen faktisk kan få tilgang på psykolog ved oppståtte behov og bestillinger. Tilbyder skal kunne tilby psykologer med relevant spesialkompetanse og erfaring, tilpasset den enkelte pasients problemstilling, behov og tjenestens art. Videre skal leveransen holde høy faglig kvalitet og sikre at tjenestene ytes i samsvar med gjeldende krav til faglig forsvarlighet, personvern og informasjonssikkerhet.

title: Rv.7 Utbedringstiltak - V01 Gulsvik sandtak
description: Prosjektet er et kurveutbedringsprosjekt på rv. 7 Hallingdalsvegen i Flå kommune, Buskerud fylke og er en del av en større plan for utbedring av rv. 7 Hallingdalsvegen på strekningen Kittilsviki - Svenkerud. Parsell V01 Gulsvik sandtak er planlagt gjennomført i perioden oktober 2026- oktober 2027 Prosjektet gjennomføres i regi av Statens vegvesen, Utbygging Sørøst, Prosjekt Buskerud og Akershus (PBA). Prosjektet er finansiert gjennom bompengeinnkreving på rv. 7 Brekkebygda, jfr. prop. 77 S. Arbeidene for Parsell V01 Gulsvik sandtak omfatter: Omlegging av eksisterende veglinje med kurveutbedring og bygging av ny veg i dagen. Vegarbeider: * Avskoging * Jordmasser * Sprenging * Sprengt fjell til mellomlager * Sprengt stein i linja * Sikring av fjellskjæringer * Riving av faste dekker * Fresing av faste faste dekker * Forsterkningslag * Bærelag (øvre + nedre) * Asfalt (bindlag + slitelag) Grøntanlegg/belegning: * Sikringsgjerde Overvann og drenering: * Stikkrenne/kulvert Ø300-Ø2400 * Overvannsledning * Drensledning * Sandfang * Overvannskum Elektro og belysning: * Trekkerør m/grøft Strøsilo: * Sanering av strøsilo delvis i berg

title: Bygging av Lindås nedre gravplass (ny utlysning)
description: Alver kyrkjelege fellesråd har fått i oppdrag av Alver kommune å bygge ny gravplass på Lindås. Kirkegården ved Lindås kyrkje har vært nærmest full i lengre tid, og behovet for ny gravplass på Lindås har vært en vedvarende situasjon i flere år. Det skal derfor anskaffes ny gravplass på Lindås, som blant annet inkluderer gravearbeid, elektroarbeid, rørlegging med vannuttak og gartnerarbeid. Det er kun arbeider knyttet til fase 1 som omfattes av denne avtalen. Kontrakten omfatter vegetasjon, dekker, kanter og møblering, samt elektro, rørlegging og grave- og grunnarbeider.For utfyllende informasjon om oppdraget, se oppdragsgivers behovsbeskrivelse og kravspesifikasjon i Bilag 1 med vedlegg.

title: Torsahagen barnehage - rehabilitering av uterom
description: Uterommet ved Torsahagen barnehage skal rehabiliteres.

title: Anskaffelse av konsulenttjenester for atomsikkerhet, inkludert håndtering av brukt brensel, strålevern og risikovurdering
description: Direktoratet for strålevern og atomsikkerhet skal anskaffe av konsulenttjenester som vil omfatte rådgivning, utvikling av skriftlig veiledningsmateriell og kompetansehevingsaktiviteter for DSA knyttet til nukleær sikkerhet og strålevern. Det skal også omfatte gjennomgang og vurdering av dokumenter mottatt fra operatøren(e).Eksempler på arbeid under avtale, vil kunne være (listen er ikke uttømmende):Gjennomgang og vurdering av lisens-/tillatelsessøknader eller tilhørende dokumentasjon og/eller rådgivning og/eller kompetansebyggingsaktiviteter til støtte for slike prosesser, inkludert:• nye fordeponeringsanlegg eller andre anlegg for håndtering av kjerneavfall• bruk av transportcontainere/transportbeholdere for brukt kjernebrensel• konfigurasjonsstyring ved kjernekraftanlegg• analyse av sikkerhets- og/eller styrings- og/eller beredskapsordninger for kjernekraftanlegg• risiko- og/eller sikkerhetsvurderinger for å bestemme deres tilstrekkelighet, fullstendighet og samsvar med nasjonale og internasjonale forskrifter og veiledninger, og internasjonal beste praksis• utførelse av uavhengige vurderinger, inkludert risiko- og sikkerhetsvurderinger

title: Vintervedlikehold Harstad kommune 2026–2030
description: Bakgrunn Harstad Kommune har behov for å sikre et stabilt, trygt og forsvarlig vintervedlikehold av kommunale veger og tilhørende anlegg i vintersesongene fra 2026 og fremover. Anskaffelsen skal bidra til god fremkommelighet for innbyggere, næringstrafikk, kollektivtransport, utrykningskjøretøy og øvrige trafikanter, samt redusere risiko for ulykker og driftsforstyrrelser som følge av snø- og isforhold. For å ivareta kommunens driftsansvar gjennom vinterhalvåret har Harstad Kommune behov for entreprenører med tilstrekkelig kapasitet, lokalkunnskap og beredskap til å utføre vintervedlikehold i definerte brøyteroder. Anskaffelsen skal sikre forutsigbare leveranser og en hensiktsmessig organisering av vinterdriften i de aktuelle områdene. Kommunen ønsker derfor å inngå kontrakter for utførelse av vintervedlikehold på nærmere angitte roder, der leverandørene skal kunne levere en fullverdig tjeneste i samsvar med konkurransegrunnlaget, rodekart og kontraktsvilkår. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen omfatter utførelse av vintervedlikehold i Harstad Kommune, herunder snøbrøyting, snørydding, strøing, levering av strøsand samt oppsett, supplering og nedtaking av brøytestikk. I tillegg inngår annet vintervedlikeholdsarbeid som følger av konkurransegrunnlaget og kontraktsvilkårene. Oppdraget gjelder kommunale brøyteroder bestående av kommunale veger og eventuelle tilhørende anlegg i henhold til rodekart. Tilbyder skal sette seg grundig inn i den enkelte rode og kunne tilby en fullverdig tjeneste for den eller de rodene det gis tilbud på. Anskaffelsen er delt inn i 6 roder, og det er adgang til å gi tilbud på én eller flere av disse: Rode 09 Medkila – Kanebogen – Åsby – Stangnes Rode 11 Harstadbotn – Seljestad – Gangsås – Grønnebakkan Rode 16 Ervik – Stornes – Elveneshaugen Rode 21 Lundenes – Fenes Rode 22 Grøtavær – Dale Rode Kjøtta Kontraktsperioden er 4 år med planlagt oppstart høsten 2026. I tillegg kommer opsjon på forlengelse i 1 + 1 år, slik at samlet mulig kontraktslengde er inntil 6 år. Opsjonene innebærer en ensidig rett for Harstad Kommune til å forlenge kontrakten på uendrede vilkår. Dersom entreprenøren ikke er varslet om annet innen 1. juni i det aktuelle kontrakts- eller opsjonsåret, løper opsjonen automatisk videre i samsvar med kontraktsvilkårene.

title: 26/02599 Anskaffelse av flowcytometer (celleteller)
description: NIBIO i Bodø skal anskaffe et kompakt flowcytometer til forskningsbruk. Instrumentet skal brukes til å telle og analysere små biologiske partikler, blant annet celler, cellekjerner og protoplaster, i arbeid med tang og tare, marine mikroorganismer og biologiske ressurser.

title: Netherlands – Software-related services – Zelfscan as a Service - Conditionerende Onderzoeken
description: Het betreft de inkoop van een intelligente (webbased) SaaS-applicatie voor de geautomatiseerde uitvoering van Zelfscans, fungerend als poortwachter voor alle grondroeringen. Gebruikers (engineers, werkvoorbereiders en aannemers) moeten tracés kunnen inlezen of handmatig invoeren. Vervolgens genereert het systeem op basis van kaartlagen real-time een status (Groen/Oranje/Rood) voor respectievelijk bodem, ontplofbare oorlogsresten, archeologie en flora en fauna. Op basis van de thans bij ons bekende informatie ramen wij de omvang van deze aanbesteding op een bandbreedte van 28.000 tot 45.000 Zelfscans per jaar. Eén Zelfscan omvat hierbij de geautomatiseerde toetsing op alle vier de onderzoeksthema's (bodemkwaliteit, archeologie, flora & fauna en ontplofbare oorlogsresten) Doorgerekend naar de looptijd van de Raamovereenkomst komt dit neer op: • Geraamde hoeveelheid over de initiële looptijd (4 jaar): circa 112.000 tot 180.000 Zelfscans; • Geraamde hoeveelheid over de totale maximale looptijd (8 jaar, inclusief beide verlengingsopties): circa 224.000 tot 320.000 Zelfscans.

title: Netherlands – Social work and related services – Begeleiden naar werk & meedoen – complexe doelgroepen 18+
description: De opdracht ziet toe op re-integratie/participatiebegeleiding (begeleiding naar werk en meedoen) en parallel daaraan vanaf start opdracht aanbieden van zinvolle dagbestedingsactiviteiten (geënt op scholing, werk, vrijwilligerswerk en/of persoonlijke ontwikkeling) aan inwoners van 18 jaar en ouder met complexe problematiek. De problematiek wordt veelal door de persoon zelf ontkend, en varieert sterk per individu. Veelal leidt dit ook tot overlast en onrust in de openbare ruimte. Zie aanbestedingsdocumenten. Perceel 1: mannen We schatten in dat 20 mannen per jaar begeleiding nodig hebben. Perceel 2: vrouwen We schatten in dat 40 vrouwen per jaar begeleiding nodig hebben. Perceel 3: delinquente personen We schatten in dat 10 tot 15 personen per jaar begeleiding nodig hebben. De inschatting voor perceel 1 is gebaseerd op de huidige opdracht, voor de andere percelen is dit een aanname. Wij merken daarbij op dat de opdracht is vervat in een raamovereenkomst, zonder volume-, omzet- en afnamegarantie. De aantallen kunnen door tal van omstandigheden, waaronder maar niet-limitatief budgetontwikkeling of politieke keuzes, fluctueren. Aan deze getallen kunnen derhalve geen rechten worden ontleend. Zie aanbestedingsdocumenten.

title: France – Highways engineering services – Etudes approfondies de vulnérabilité du réseau autoroutier COFIROUTE aux risques crue et inondation
description: Le marché porte sur la réalisation d'études de vulnérabilité de l’infrastructure autoroutière et de ses ouvrages aux risques de crue et d'inondation, sur environ 118 km du réseau COFIROUTE répartis en douze zones d'étude. Les prestations comprennent la réalisation de modélisations hydrologiques et hydrauliques, et de missions de maîtrise d’œuvre de niveau « diagnostic » et « études préliminaires » de solutions d’aménagement permettant de limiter les impacts des crues et inondations sur l’infrastructure autoroutière, ainsi que le pilotage de prestations accessoires participant à la réalisation de l’étude de vulnérabilité. Le présent marché est décomposé en douze (12) zones géographiques techniquement homogènes. title: Germany – Construction work for kindergarten buildings – Totalübernehmerleistungen für den Neubau einer 5-gruppigen Kindertagesstätte in 45883 Gelsenkirchen
description: Der Auftraggeber beabsichtigt, Totalübernehmerleistungen für den Neubau einer 5-gruppigen Kindertagesstätte in der Küppersbuschstr. 1a in 45883 Gelsenkirchen als Holz-Beton-Hybridbau einschließlich aller erforderlichen Frei- und Außenanlagen zu vergeben. Derzeit liegt eine Machbarkeitsstudie vor. Gegenstand des zu vergebenden Auftrags sind alle erforderlichen Objekt- und Fachplanungsleistungen sowie Bauleistungen zur schlüsselfertigen Errichtung der Kindertagesstätte. Die Bruttogrundfläche beträgt 1.623 m², wovon ca. 887 m² auf die Nutzfläche entfallen. Auf dem Gelände befindet sich aktuell das Bestandsgebäude einer 5-gruppigen Kindertageseinrichtung, das aufgrund von Wasserschäden leer steht und vom Auftraggeber abgerissen wird. Die Abrissarbeiten sind nicht Teil dieses Auftrags. Eine Übergangs- bzw. Interimslösung ist nicht erforderlich. Die bisherige Planung sieht vor, die Gruppenräume in hausähnlichen Einheiten zu organisieren, die sich zu einem hofartig angelegten Ensemble verbinden. Um eine ausreichende Anzahl an Gruppen unterzubringen und dem steigenden Bedarf gerecht zu werden, ist die Kindertagesstätte als zweigeschossiger Baukörper geplant. Weitere Einzelheiten sind der über die Vergabeplattform bereitgestellten Machbarkeitsstudie zu entnehmen. Bei der Planung ist das Building Information Modeling (BIM-Methode) anzuwenden. Nach dem aktuellen Zeitplan ist die Einreichung des Bauantrags für das 3. Quartal 2027 und die Fertigstellung der Kindertagesstätte zu Beginn des KiTa-Jahres 2029/2030 im August 2029 vorgesehen. Weitere Details dazu teilt der Auftraggeber den ausgewählten Bewerbern nach Ende des Teilnahmewettbewerbs mit.

title: Norway – Geographic information systems (GIS or equivalent) – GIS - Map systems for insight and management.
description: IKTNH shall hold a tender competition on GIS - map systems for insight and management. The municipalities of Elves, Aurland, Austrheim, Austevoll, Etne, Fedje, Gulen, Masfjorden, Modalen, Osterøy, Samnanger, Sveio, Tysnes, Vaksdal and Vindafjord have established a joint ICT operations company, ICT Nordhordland municipal joint partnership (IKTNH). This enquiry is mainly for: Procurement of GIS Platform. It will be open for complete and/or sub-delivery with the following alternatives: 1. System for GIS, which only includes a map system for insight and theme data management. 2. System for GIS, which only includes a map system for administration. The procurement(s) shall ensure future orientated systems for the municipalities in the cooperation, as well as to the greatest possible degree contribute to simplifying, improving and digitising work processes connected to map systems. The offered system must be in continual development and give users access to new versions and functionality. This also applies for the national joint components. The municipalities shall be offered new technologies as and when they become available and interesting. The functionality shall be available after the simplest possible price model that does not limit development, and with the greatest possible integration between different services and technologies. It is also a requirement that the system and the agreement, in all relevant areas, support an ever closer cooperation between the different municipalities and any new municipalities that become part of the cooperation. The tenderer shall contribute to the municipalities ́ work for sharing competence, training and experience exchange between the municipalities in the entire process. We require that the tenderer actively contributes to achieving all our aims.

description: Die GASCADE Gastransport GmbH betreibt drei (3) Biogaseinspeiseanlagen. Die anfallen-den Arbeiten für Wartung und Instandhaltung (in nachfolgenden "Betriebsführung") sollen hierzu an fachkundige Unternehmen vergeben werden. Gegenstand des Auftrags ist die technische Betriebsführung sowie die Durchführung, Koordination und Dokumentation sämtli-cher erforderlicher Inspektions-, Wartungs-, Prüfungs- und Instandhaltungsleistungen an den Biogaseinspeiseanlagen Fuchswinkel, Nonnendorf und Wörth. Die Biogaseinspeiseanlage Fuchswinkel umfasst zusätzlich eine Sauerstoffentfernungsanlage. Der Leistungsumfang erstreckt sich insbesondere auf die Gasdruckregel- und Messanlagen, Verdichteranlagen, Sauerstoffentfernungsanlagen, Mess-, Steuerungs-, Fernwirk- und Über-tragungstechnik, elektrotechnischen Anlagen, Explosions- und Brandschutztechnik, Hei-zungs-, Lüftungs- und Klimaanlagen, Druckluft- und Steuerluftanlagen, Druckbehälter, Ge-bäude und Außenanlagen sowie die Koordination und Begleitung wiederkehrender Prüfungen. Eingeschlossen sind ferner die Störungsbearbeitung einschließlich der Sicherstellung vorge-gebener Reaktionszeiten, die Einbindung qualifizierter Fach- und Serviceunternehmen, die Abfallentsorgung, die Erfassung und Minimierung von Methanemissionen sowie die vollstän-dige Dokumentation und Berichterstattung. Die Leistungen sind unter Beachtung der ein-schlägigen gesetzlichen Bestimmungen, technischen Regelwerke, Herstellervorgaben und der vorgegebenen Prüf- und Wartungsintervalle zu erbringen.

title: Germany – Building construction work – Vergoldung Kuppel
description: Schlossbesitz Linderhof, Maurischer Kiosk Instandsetzung von Dach und Fassaden Hier: Vergoldung Kuppel Im Schlosspark Linderhof von Schloss Linderhof wird der sog. Maurische Kiosk Instand gesetzt. Bei dem Objekt handelt es sich um den ältesten noch existenten Messebau (1867). Der mit Ecktürmchen und einer Mittelkuppel in 12 m Höhe bekrönte Maurische Kiosk hat eine Grundfläche von rund 9 m x 9 m. Die gusseiserne Ständerkonstruktion ist mit eisernen Verstrebungen, Vierkanthölzern und Gipsplatten ausgefacht. Außen ist die Fassade mit rund 2.000 ornamentierten Bronze-, Zink- und Eisengussplatten bekleidet, die aufwendig gefasst und vergoldet sind. Bei der Exedra handelt es sich um eine Ergänzung, die erst beim Aufbau in Linderhof 1876 hinzugefügt wurde. Ziel der jetzigen Arbeiten ist die grundlegende restauratorische Überarbeitung aller Elemente der Außenhaut und der konstruktiven Bauteile. Dabei sollen Schäden behoben, die Statik ertüchtigt und die Oberfläche neu gefasst werden. Der vorhandene Fassungsaufbau enthält Bleimennige und Bleiweiß. Zudem sollen präventive Maßnahmen zum Schutz des Gebäudes in die Arbeiten integriert werden. Die Sanierung erfolgt grob in vier Abschnitte mit einer jährlichen Bearbeitung von je einer Fassade im Norden, Westen und Osten. Die südliche Eingangsfassade benötigt aufgrund besonderer Bearbeitung vor Ort etwas länger. Während der Arbeiten ergibt sich ein Rhythmus durch die Demontage der Fassadenplatten im Herbst, deren Bearbeitung in der Werkstatt der beauftragten Restauratoren und die anschließende Remontage im Sommer des darauffolgenden Jahres. Um ein halbes Jahr versetzt und parallel hierzu erfolgt die zweijährige Restaurierung der Dachbereiche unter einem temporären Wetterschutzgerüst, sowie die Sanierung der Treppenanlage und der geschädigten Stützmauer Putze.

title: Denmark – Coastal-defence works – Køge Dige – Diger, højvandsmure og højvandsport i Snogebækken
description: Køge er gennem tiden blevet ramt af nogle særdeles kraftige stormfloder og er dermed oversvømmet flere gange. Som følge af den klimatisk betingede havspejlsstigning forventes hyppigheden af oversvømmelse af Køge at stige i fremtiden. Staten har udpeget Køge Bugt som risikoområde for oversvømmelse i henhold til EU’s oversvømmelsesdirektiv. Køge Kommune har på denne baggrund iværksat et kystbeskyttelsesprojekt, Køge Dige. Køge Dige har til formål at beskytte Køge Kommunes kystnære byområder imod oversvømmelse fra havet, og vil, når det står færdigt, strække sig over det meste af Køge Kommunes kyststrækning fra Skensved Å i nord, ned over Køge Havn og mod Vedskølle Å i syd. Kystbeskyttelsen vil bestå af diger, højvandsmure og højvandsporte, samt pumper til håndtering af vand fra baglandet. Køge Dige er opdelt i tre delområder: Delområde 1: Københavnsvej. Den nordlige del, der strækker sig fra kommunegrænsen mod Solrød Kommune til det punkt langs Værtsvej, nord for Køge Marina, hvor eksisterende terræn i sig selv bliver tilstrækkeligt højt til at udgøre beskyttelse. Her etableres kystbeskyttelsen som udgangspunkt som et dige øst for Københavnsvej og uden om byområderne øst for Københavnsvej, ligesom der etableres en højvandsport i Snogebækken. Ved Havstokken etableres en kombination af højvandsmur og dige på en kort strækning. Pumpestationer i dette delområde udbydes særskilt, og skal etableres i en anden entreprise - ikke omfattet af nærværende udbud. Delområde 2: Køge Marina og Køge Havn. Den centrale del af Køge Dige omfatter Køge Marina og Køge Havn. På denne del består kystbeskyttelsen af højvandsmure, og terrænhævninger på den nordlige del af havnen, samt en stor højvandsport i den offentlige havn (Slipset). Opgaven ved etablering af den store højvandsport i Køge Havn, med tilhørende portkanal og pumpestation, udbydes i separat udbud med tilhørende leverancekontrakt, og den er ikke en del af herværende entreprise - ikke omfattet af nærværende udbud. På Søndre Havn er det alene kystbeskyttelse ved Køge Roklub, som indgår som en del af Køge Dige og nærværende udbud. Delområde 3: Strandvejen. Det sydlige område omfatter strækningen fra Strandpromenaden ved Kjøge Miniby til Vedskølle Å. Her fungerer Strandvejen på størstedelen af strækningen som beskyttelsen. Der etableres et dige rundt om Hotel Comwell, og den skovvej, som forløber gennem et skovområde umiddelbart nord for Vedskølle Å, forhøjes. Den udbudte hovedentreprisekontrakt omfatter højvands-/kystbeskyttelse i de tre delområder ved etablering af cirka: • 5.000 meter diger • 1.900 meter grøfter langs bagside af diger • Indbygning af ca. 75.000 kubikmeter jord • 1.400 meter højvandsmure/spuns med åbninger til skots • 400 meter terrænregulering • Højvandsport i Snogebækken. Det udbudte anlægsarbejde er mere detaljeret beskrevet i udbudsmaterialet.

description: Die GASCADE Gastransport GmbH ("GASCADE") betreibet als deutscher Fernleitungsnetzbetreiber ein Gashochdrucknetz von 3.700 km für Erdgas und Wasserstoff in Dimensionen von DN 150 bis DN 1400 im Geltungsbereich der Gashochdruckleitungsverordnung (GasHDrLtgV). description: Het betreft de inkoop van een intelligente (webbased) SaaS-applicatie voor de geautomatiseerde uitvoering van Zelfscans, fungerend als poortwachter voor alle grondroeringen. Gebruikers (engineers, werkvoorbereiders en aannemers) moeten tracés kunnen inlezen of handmatig invoeren. Op basis van de thans bij ons bekende informatie ramen wij de omvang van deze aanbesteding op een bandbreedte van 28.000 tot 45.000 Zelfscans per jaar. Eén Zelfscan omvat hierbij de geautomatiseerde toetsing op alle vier de onderzoeksthema's (bodemkwaliteit, archeologie, flora & fauna en ontplofbare oorlogsresten) Doorgerekend naar de looptijd van de Raamovereenkomst komt dit neer op: • Geraamde hoeveelheid over de initiële looptijd (4 jaar): circa 112.000 tot 180.000 Zelfscans; • Geraamde hoeveelheid over de totale maximale looptijd (8 jaar, inclusief beide verlengingsopties): circa 224.000 tot 320.000 Zelfscans.

description: Die Universität Hamburg (UHH) ist mit mehr als 40.000 Studierenden und ca. 12.000 Mitarbeitenden eine der größten Forschungs- und Ausbildungseinrichtungen Norddeutschlands. Sie nutzt ihre Räumlichkeiten und Außenflächen zeitweise für universitäts-eigene Veranstaltungen, etwa Tagungen, Ausstellungen oder wissenschaftliche Vortragsveranstaltungen, sowie für Veranstaltungen Dritter mit zumeist wissenschaftsnaher Ausrichtung. Die Universität beabsichtigt zu diesem Zweck eine Rahmenvereinbarung gemäß § 21 VgV für die Dienstleistung der Veranstaltungsleitung abzuschließen. Für diese Rahmenvereinbarung ist eine Laufzeit von 12 Monaten mit der Option auf dreimalige Verlängerung um jeweils 12 weitere Monate vorgesehen. Der Rahmenvertrag hat damit eine Maximallaufzeit von 48 Monaten. Es ist ein Beginn zum 1. Dezember 2026 vorgesehen. Das jährliche Volumen wird unverbindlich auf 1.000 Einsatzstunden geschätzt, wovon ca. 70 % von Veranstaltungsleiter*innen höherer Qualifikation (Meister*innen/ Veranstaltungsfachwirt*innen) geleistet werden. Das maximale Gesamtvolumen der Rahmenvereinbarung liegt bei 6.000 Einsatzstunden über die maximale Gesamtlaufzeit des Vertrags.

title: Germany – Architectural services for outdoor areas – Kuhlache Ost – Freianlagenplanung Leistungsphasen 3 bis 9 im Rahmen der Vorbereitung der Landesgartenschau Lutherstadt Wittenberg 2028
description: Die 6. Sachsen-Anhaltische Landesgartenschau findet im Jahr 2028 in der Lutherstadt Wittenberg statt, einer Stadt, deren Geschichte untrennbar mit der Reformation verbunden ist. Mit der Schlosskirche, der Stadtkirche St. Marien, dem Lutherhaus und dem Melanchthonhaus verfügt sie über vier UNESCOWelterbestätten. Zugleich ist Wittenberg eine Stadt an der Elbe. Die Flusslandschaft prägt ihren Landschaftsraum und bildet den Übergang zwischen historischer Altstadt und Fluss Die Landesgartenschau Lutherstadt Wittenberg 2028 steht unter der Leitidee „Gartenschau im Welterbe“. Die Kuhlache bildet einen zentralen Landschafts- und Ausstellungsbereich zwischen historischer Stadt und Elbe. Für den Teilbereich Kuhlache Ost liegt ein Vorentwurf auf dem Stand der Leistungsphasen 1 und 2, für Freianlagen nach HOAI 2021 vor. Gegenstand der Vergabe ist die planerische Fortschreibung dieses Vorentwurfs in den Leistungsphasen 3 bis 9. Die weitere Planung hat auf den vorhandenen Planungsgrundlagen, der räumlichen Grundidee sowie den in den Anlagen dokumentierten Gestaltungsprinzipien und Leitbildern aufzubauen. Auf einer Revitalisierungsfläche von rund 25.500 m² soll ein hochwertiger, dauerhaft nutzbarer Landschaftspark entstehen. Während der Landesgartenschau bildet die Kuhlache Ost den Kernbereich der gärtnerischen Präsentationen und Besucherangebote.

title: Straßenbahn-Neubaustrecke „Neues Uniklinikum Würzburg“ - Geotechnische Baubegleitung
description: Die Würzburger Straßenbahn GmbH (WSB) betreibt im eigenen Namen, auf eigene Rechnung und auf eigenes Risiko auf Grundlage eines öffentlichen Dienstleistungsauftrages gemäß Art. 3 Abs. 1 VO 1370/2007 zwischen der Stadt Würzburg und der WSB im örtlichen Zuständigkeitsbereich der Stadt Würzburg den öffentlichen Personennahverkehr mit Straßenbahnen und Omnibussen. In diesem Gesamtkontext ist die WSB aufgefordert, folgende Linienerweiterung (Gesamtmaßnahme) baulich umzusetzen: Das bestehende meterspurige Straßenbahnliniennetz in Würzburg wird durch die WSB mit der geplanten Baumaßnahme Straßenbahn-Neubaustrecke „Neues Uniklinikum Würzburg“ erweitert. Hierdurch wird das Nordgelände und die geplante Erweiterung des Universitätsklinikums Würzburg (Kopfklinikum, Frauenklinik, Zentrum Operative Fächer ZOM, Zentrum für Innere Medizin ZIM) (UKW) von der Straßenbahn erschlossen und an die Innenstadt von Würzburg angebunden. Für die Durchführung der Gesamtmaßnahme Straßenbahn-Neubaustrecke „Neues Uniklinikum Würzburg“ sind diverse Leistungen für die geotechnische Baubegleitung zu erbringen. Hierzu zählen u.a.: - Probenahmen; - Untersuchungen; sowie - Einbau/Verdichtungskontrolle.

description: Es ist geplant die Kläranlage Edelweiler bis auf die mechanische Stufe zurückzubauen und das Abwasser mit einer Regenwettermenge von 42 m³/h über eine Druckleitung in das Einzugsgebiet der Kläranlage Vörbach des ZVA Oberes Waldachtal zu pumpen. Die Planungsleistung umfasst den Rückbau der Kläranlage Edelweiler unter Weiterbetrieb der mechanischen Stufe sowie die Planung und den Bau der Trasse inklusive Pumpwerk. Zudem ist die Prüfung und ggfs. Anpassung der Durchleitungen durch die Ortskanalisationen und Sammelleitungen Teil der Planungsleistung. Für das Pumpwerk sollen verschiedene Möglichkeiten überprüft werden auch im Hinblick auf Redundanz. Außerdem soll ein Förderantrag für die strukturelle Maßnahme des Kläranlagenumschlusses gestellt werden.

Für diese Maßnahmen sind die Untersuchung und die Beurteilung des Baugrundes erforderlich. Gegenstand der Vergabe sind die dafür erforderlichen Baugrunderkundungen inkl. Feld- und Laborversuche.

title: Germany – Construction work – Neubau Kita Kruft
description: Bei dem Bauvorhaben handelt es sich um den Neubau einer Kindertagesstätte in der Vulkanstraße in 56642 Kruft. Das Baugrundstück liegt in einem Hanggelände im Nord-Osten der bebauten Ortslage von Kruft. Zufahrt und Andienung der Baustelle erfolgen über die Vulkanstraße als öffentlicher Verkehrsweg. Die Kita wird als T-förmiges Gebäude mit einer Kantenlänge von ca. 42 x 40 m errichtet. Durch die Hanglage wird der Baukörper in der Höhe zweigeschossig gestaffelt: auf Eingangsniveau, das von der Vulkanstraße aus erschlossen wird, befindet sich der Zugang zur Kita, der Verwaltungsbereich, der Mehrzweckraum, das Bistro und die Küche, Technikräume sowie die Krippengruppe mit Nebenräumen. Im "Obergeschoß", das sich ebenerdig zu den Freiflächen am Hang öffnet, befinden sich weitere fünf Gruppenräume mit Neben- und Schlafräumen sowie der Personalräume . Vor den Gruppenräumen befindet sich ein überdachtes Spieldeck, das den Zugang zu dem Außenspielgelände ermöglicht. Das Dach des Baukörpers im Erdgeschoß und Teile des Dachs des Obergeschosses werden extensiv begrünt. Auf der Pultdachfläche des Obergeschosses werden zusätzlich Photovoltaik-Module errichtet. Fläche des Baugrundstückes: insgesamt ca. 13.370 m2 Überbauter Bereich: insgesamt ca. 2.290 m2 Bauteile und Baustoffe: Stahlbetonbodenplatte gemäß Statik und Bodengutachten; Einzelfundamente/Streifenfundamente aus Stahlbeton, nach DIN EN 1992 auf Gründungspolster (Schotter); oberseitige Schweißbahnabdichtung. Außenwände: einschaliges Mauerwerk, d= 36,5cm, aus Wärmedämm-Leichtbetonstein; wärmegedämmte Betonbauteile (Stürze, Stützen, etc.) mit Putz und Anstrich Innenwände: alle tragenden und nichttragenden Innenwände werden in Mauerwerk bzw. in Stahlbeton gem. Statik ausgeführt. Dachkonstruktion EG : Flachdach als massive Stahlbetondecke Dachkonstruktion OG: flach geneigtes Dach in Holzbauweise mit statischen Sonderelementen in Profilstahl; Gefälle ca. 3,5% Dacheindeckung : Warmdach mit Wärmedämmung als Auf- und in Teilen auch Zwischensparrendämmung gem. GEG-Berechnung/-planung, Abdichtung 2-lagig mittels gründachgeeigneter Bitumenschweißbahnen Fensterkonstruktion: Fenster- u. Fenstertüren aus Kunststoff mit 3-fach Isolierverglasung, gem. GEG-Nachweis; Außenfensterbänke aus Aluminium. Große Fenster- und Fenstertürelemente:Aluminium mit 3-fach Isolierverglasung, gem. GEG-Nachweis. Verdunklung/Sonnenschutz: elektr. betriebene Textilscreens und Raffstore je nach Einsatzgebiet. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist das Los 10 Raumlufttechnik.

title: Finland – Electricity – Sähköenergian hankinta
description: Hankinnan kohteena on sähköenergian ja salkunhoitopalvelujen hankinta. Hankinta toteutetaan Sansian hallinnoimana yhteishankintana, jossa tilaajina ovat Mikkelin kaupunki, Etelä-Savon Koulutus Oy, Metsäsairila Oy, Mikalo Oy ja Mikkelin Asumisoikeus Oy. Hankinnassa sähköenergian hinta muodostuu fyysisen sähkön spot-toimituksesta, hintariskin vähentämiseksi tehtyjen tehopohjaisten hinnankiinnitysten selvityksestä, uusiutuvan sähkön alkuperätodistusten hankinnasta, toimittajan marginaalista sekä kantaverkkoyhtiö Fingridin kulloinkin voimassa olevasta tuotannon ja kulutuksen volyymimaksusta. Hankinnan määräaikainen sopimuskausi on 1.1.2029 - 31.12.2030. Sen lisäksi hankintaan sisältyy sopimusosapuolten yhteisesti päätettävä jatko-optio 1.1.2031 -31.12.2032. Tilaajien yhteenlaskettu sähköenergian hankinta on noin 38,2 GWh/vuosi. Ilmoitettu määrä on arvio, jossa esiintyy vuosittaista vaihtelua. Tilaajakohtaisia käyttöpaikkamääriä ja arvioituja sähköenergian hankintamääriä on tarkemmin kuvattu tarjouspyynnön liitteessä. Kaikki esitetyt käyttöpaikkamäärät ja volyymit ovat arvioita, eivätkä hankintayksikkö ja tilaajat sitoudu niiden mukaisiin hankintamääriin. Tarjoajia pyydetään tutustumaan kaikkiin tarjouspyynnön liitteenä oleviin asiakirjoihin ja huomioimaan ne tarjousta tehdessään. Hankintaan valitaan yksi (1) toimittaja.

title: Finland – System maintenance services – Turvajärjestelmien huolto- ja ylläpitopalveluiden hankinta
description: Hankinnan kohteena on Oulun yliopiston ja Oulun Ammattikorkeakoulu Oy:n (OAMK) turvajärjestelmien ylläpitopalvelu. Hankinnan tavoitteena on muodostaa Tilaajalle yhtenäinen toimintamalli turvajärjestelmien ylläpitoon, huoltoon, muutostöihin ja elinkaaren hallintaan. Hankinta koskee Tilaajan turvajärjestelmiä kaikissa sen kohteissa. Hankinnan piiriin kuuluvat myös sopimuskauden aikana käyttöönotettavat uudet kohteet sekä olemassa oleviin kohteisiin toteutettavat laajennukset ja muutokset. Tällä hetkellä Oulun yliopisto toimii ensisijaisena tilaajana ja läpilaskuttaa kustannukset Oulun Ammattikorkeakoululta (OAMK). Sopimuskauden aikana myös Oamkilla voi syntyä omia hankintatarpeita, jotka liittyvät esimerkiksi järjestelmien uudistamiseen tai korvaamiseen. Oulun yliopiston konsulttina tässä kilpailutuksessa toimii Seclion Oy. Hankinnan kuvaus tarkemmin liitteissä "Hankinnan yleiskuvaus" ja "Palvelukuvaus".

title: Finland – Food, beverages, tobacco and related products – Päivittäis- ja kulutustavaraostojen hankinta
description: Salon kaupunki (jäljempänä hankintayksikkö/tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia päivittäis- ja kulutustavaraostojen hankinnoista vuosille 2027 - 2028 tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Lisäksi hankintayksikkö varaa mahdollisuuden kahteen optiovuoteen 2029 ja 2030. Optiolla tarkoitetaan mahdollisuutta sopimuksen jatkamiseen alkuperäisin ehdoin. Optioiden käytöstä ja kestosta päätetään erikseen. Hankinta tullaan toteuttamaan puitejärjestelynä tarjouspyynnössä kuvatulla tavalla. Hankinnan kohteena ovat elintarvikkeet, päivittäistavarat ja kulutustavarat. Hankinta sisältää mm. seuraavat tuoteryhmät: elintarvikkeet, päivittäistavarat, sisustustuotteet ja kausitarvikkeet, kotikeittiötarvikkeet, muovi- ja säilytystarvikkeet, kertakäyttöastiat, pienelektroniikka ja pienkodinkoneet sekä muut mahdolliset tuoteryhmät, joita ei pystytä erikseen yksilöimään. Hankinta koskee koko Salon kaupunkia ja ostoja tekevät kaupungin eri palvelualueet paikan päällä toimittajan päivittäistavarakaupassa tai myymälässä. Hankinta on jaettu kahteen osa-alueeseen ja tarjoaja voi jättää tarjouksen joko yhteen tai useampaan osa-alueeseen.

title: SPS-02372 Conservation Strategy for Selected SPS Historic Estate Assets
description: The Scottish Prison Service (SPS) requires a suitably qualified multidisciplinary supplier to prepare three (3) Conservation Strategies for selected historic assets across its estate. The commission will cover the following sites: HMP Barlinnie (Glasgow), HMP Castle Huntly (near Dundee) and HMP Perth (Perth). The Conservation Strategies will act as practical, significance-led management tools to support maintenance, repair, operation, adaptation, and future decision-making for historic and listed buildings. The work will include (but is not limited to): 1) Review of baseline information and historic development 2) Building and fabric surveys 3) Structural appraisal input 4) Significance assessments 5) Condition surveys and defect registers 6) Preparation of marked-up drawings showing significance and risk 7) Development of prioritised action plans (short to long term) 8) Maintenance and operational guidance for estates teams 9) Advice on statutory consent and engagement with Historic Environment Scotland and planning authorities 10) Site-specific conservation policies The outputs will comprise three Conservation Strategies, one per site, supported by drawings, action plans, and guidance documents.

title: Total Force eLearning
description: THIS NOTICE IS ISSUED AS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE AND IS FOR INFORMATION PURPOSES ONLY. This notice DOES NOT constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), Invitation for Bid (IFB), solicitation, or package requesting technical competencies/qualifications of the prospective contractor, nor does it represent any commitment by the Government. Since this is a Sources Sought Notice, no evaluation letters and/or results will be issued to the respondents. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this notice nor does this obligate the Government to award a contract. No telephone calls will be accepted requesting a bid package or solicitation. A solicitation does not presently exist. The Air Force will not accept or acknowledge: emails over 10MB, brochures, samples, catalogs, and any other marketing solicitation information. The Government is performing market research primarily in order to determine if there are firms that possess the capability to execute the requirements of this sources sought notice. Therefore, we further invite all business concerns to provide a capability statement in response to this requirement. Prospective contractors shall be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) prior to award of any Federal Government contract. Contractors are encouraged to obtain further information on SAM registration at the following website: https://www.sam.gov/ If your firm would be interested in such work, you are strongly encouraged to submit a capability statement that addresses as a minimum the questions presented within this notice and submit it to the point of contact listed below by the due date. The Government does not intend to rank submittals or provide any reply to interested firms. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code 611430 � Professional and Management Development Training, is applicable to this acquisition. The small business size standard for this NAICS is $15.0M. Following submissions of a capability package, the United States Air Force (USAF) representatives may choose to engage in additional communications with selected respondents only intended to support market research for further clarification of industry capability to meet requirements. The USAF has a requirement in support of the Air Force Civil Engineer Center (AFCEC) to procure a web-based professional development training program providing 3,500 total training hours for the Air Force Total Force (Active Duty, Civilian, Guard, and Reserve). The contractor-provided library must contain more than 2,000 accredited professional/technical engineering and architectural courses yielding Continuing Education Units (CEUs) and Professional Development Hours (PDHs) required for state and national licensing renewals. Please refer to the attached draft Statement of Objectives (SOO) for detailed requirements. Contractors who can provide these products/services are requested to identify if they are interested and submit, in writing, an affirmative response which includes as a minimum the following information: Company Information including: Company Name: Address: UEI/CAGE: Point of contact to include telephone number and email address for your company: Based on your professional experience in the private sector, would you consider this requirement to coincide with products/services provided in the commercial market? Specify your business type; large business, small business, small disadvantaged business, 8(a) certified small disadvantaged business, HUBZone small business, woman-owned small business, and service-disabled veteran-owned small business based upon NAICS 611430. Specify all that apply. Provide an additional NAICS code with justification that you would recommend as being more applicable. Does your company provide this product/service on a GSA Schedule, GSA IDIQ contract, or other Government-wide contract? If so, please provide the Contract/Schedule number and NAICS/special item number. If GSA is in the process of awarding a contract/schedule to you for this product/service, please provide the GSA point of contact name and phone number. Would your firm propose on this project as a prime contractor, prime contractor with subcontractor(s), prime contractor with team member subcontractor(s), or a joint venture? If you have proposed a joint venture, identify to the extent possible, your team members. Identify the business size of your team members or joint venture firms. If a teaming arrangement is planned, give details to the extent practicable on how the team will likely be composed. See FAR subpart 9.6 for Government policy on teaming arrangements and 8(a) Program regulations described in 13 CFR 124.513. Identify any projects completed in the past three (3) years for the same or similar scope. Include any Government contracts (Federal, State, or local) you have been awarded for this type of requirement. Also, include the contract number and a government point of contact. Identify if your company was the prime contractor or a subcontractor for these projects. Interested companies shall briefly explain how they would accomplish the objectives identified in the draft SOO, to include: Examples or screenshots of your administrative reporting dashboard. How does your system allow government administrators to track user progress, course completions, and assigned training hours in real-time? Describe the mechanism for controlling employee course access. How does your platform manage an online course approval process, and can approval hierarchies be customized? Detail your process for user account setup. How does your system capture and archive state license numbers and completion certificates? What is your data retention policy, and how can the government export this historical data? Provide a breakdown of your course library by discipline. Specifically, how many of your 2,000+ courses are focused on professional/technical engineering and architecture, versus general business or management topics? Courses must provide CEUs/PDHs that comply with state and national agencies. Describe your process for ensuring and validating that your courses are accepted by the various state licensing boards for engineering and architecture. Can you provide a list of state boards that have accepted your courses for credit? The requirement includes new course releases and updates. What is the average number of new engineering and architectural courses and live webinars you have added to your library annually over the past three years? Describe the security protocols and user authentication methods your platform uses to ensure that only authorized DAF personnel can access the training materials. Does your system have the capability to integrate with an organization's single sign-on (SSO) or identity provider? Describe your user support model. Beyond an initial webinar, what resources (e.g., help desk, knowledge base, technical support) are available to users who encounter issues with the platform or courses? Demonstrate your platform�s ability to meet Federal Information and Communication Technology (ICT) accessibility standards under 36 CFR 1194.1 (FAR Subpart 39.2). Vendors must provide a completed Voluntary Product Accessibility Template (VPAT) or an Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) demonstrating how their web platform, self-paced courses, and live webinars support assistive technologies (such as screen readers, closed captioning, and keyboard-only navigation). Interested firms are encouraged to provide suggestions on products/services that can be included on this RFI to improve the development of this requirement. All responsible sources are encouraged to submit a capability statement in response to this notice. All questions and responses shall be submitted electronically to Mrs. Grace Pennington at grace.pennington@us.af.mil and Savanna Suggs at savanna.suggs@us.af.mil no later than Tues

Urinalysis sample collection for offenders This requirement is for: The Correctional Service of Canada, Barrie, Ontario Trade agreement: This procurement is not subject to any trade agreement. Policy on Reciprocal Procurement: This solicitation is open only to Canadian suppliers. Competitive Procurement Strategy: lowest priced compliant bid. Set-aside under the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business: This procurement is not subject to any set-asides for Indigenous Suppliers. Comprehensive Land Claim Agreement: This procurement is not subject to a Comprehensive Land Claims Agreement. Security Requirements: This contract includes security requirements. Nature of Requirements: The following is a summary of the statement of work for this requirement. The Correctional Service of Canada has a requirement to provide Urinalysis Collection Services for male offenders in Barrie and the surrounding geographical area. The work will involve the following: 1.1 Objectives: Consistent with the Mission Statement and Strategic Objectives of the Correctional Service of Canada (CSC), the contractor must provide a Urinalysis Collection Program for the Barrie area extending to the surrounding rural areas. 1.2 Tasks: 1.2.1 The Contractor must: 1. Upon referral, collect urine samples from federally released male offenders. 2. Provide a collector that must be of the same gender as the offender providing the sample. 3. Accurately label, store and package samples to prevent contamination or tampering. 4. Record necessary information, including time of collection, collector identification, and complete other required documentation. 5. Explain the urinalysis process clearly to offenders, maintaining a calm and respectful demeanor. 6. Handle potentially sensitive or uncomfortable situations with discretion and empathy. 7. Ensure the integrity of the sample by placing the required seals on the container, obtain signatures on the container, and prepare the container for shipment to the specified laboratory for testing. 8. Ship the samples with a bill of lading to the approved laboratory for testing. 9. Collect samples in compliance with Section 66(1) of the CCRA regulations, and CD 566/566-11. The contractor must provide protective gloves to the collectors. 10. Present the offender with form 1064-1 (Community Notification to Provide a Urine Sample) prior to the initial test or at the beginning of a new frequency of urine collection if CSC requests one, obtain the offender’s signature, complete the Chain of Custody Form 1065 for every sample collected and distribute copies of the form as directed. 11. Complete the urinalysis log sheets monthly, or provide a detailed invoice, or both, and forward them to the respective office responsible for the supervision of the offender. 12. Attend court hearings, meetings with auditors, or meet with CSC managers as requested. 13. For all cases assessed by CSC to meet the tandem supervision policy, the contractor must provide a collector and an additional member of its staff or a person approved by the project authority who must accompany the collector whenever a urine sample is collected in the offender's private residence or in an isolated community location (CD 715). CSC will brief both the collector and the additional member of the contractor's staff or approved person on safety concerns. 14. Immediately notify the CSC supervising parole office if the collector notes that an offender refuses or is unable to provide a sample, or displays any suspicious behaviour, or both. If this occurs outside the contractor’s established working schedule, the contractor must follow the National Monitoring Centre protocol. 1.2.2 Collection Schedule: 1. Normally, the contractor must perform collections during regular working hours, Monday to Friday, between 0700 hours and 1800 hours. 2. CSC may request that the contractor collect urine samples, from time to time, on weekends and after normal working hours. 3. CSC may request that the contractor collect urine samples on an emergency basis. The contractor must respond within 3 to 4 hours of being notified of an emergency requirement. 4. The contractor must respond within 24 hours’ notice for any non urgent requests to schedule collection. 1.2.3 Continuity of Services 1. The collector must provide 24 hours’ notice for cancellation of collections. The contractor must provide this notice to the Office Urinalysis Coordinator. 2. The contractor must provide a back-up for urinalysis collection, in case of illness, vacation, leave, or the inability to provide urinalysis collection services for at least 5 days. The contractor must obtain the Departmental Representative’s or Project Authority’s prior approval before the back-up performs any work. The back-up must also complete the CSC Urinalysis Collectors Orientation Program (at the contractor’s expense) before the back-up begins providing any urine collection services. 1.2.4 Support the Contractor CSC will: 1. Ensure that the contractor is provided with all necessary documentation including Regulations, Directives, and Guidelines for compliance to be maintained. 2. Provide procedural instructions for the surveillance, procurement and shipment of samples. 3. Refer offenders for urinalysis testing. 4. Establish procedures for shipment of samples to the CSC specified laboratory for testing. 5. Facilitate the process of securing Reliability Status security clearance for the contractor and/or subcontractor providing the services. 6. Provide the required paperwork, sample containers, courier bags, courier bills of lading, a cooler to store the collection samples and an appropriate security storage container for paperwork and referrals. 7. Provide a complete CSC Urinalysis Collectors Orientation Program prior to the collector commencing any urine collection services. The orientation includes safety procedures related to reporting negative offender behaviour to the CSC supervising parole office, and the National Monitoring Centre protocol. 1.2.5 Cancellations The contractor must not charge CSC when CSC provides at least 24 hours of notice of cancellation of collections. The Parole Officer Supervisor, CCC Manager, or Office Urinalysis Coordinator will provide this notice. When CSC provides less than 24 hours notice of cancellation of collection, the contractor may charge one-half the collection rate. The Parole Officer Supervisor, CCC Manager or Office Urinalysis Coordinator will provide the cancellation notice by Telephone notification or telephone message to the contractor. 1.2.6 No Show Fee If an offender does not show up for collection of a urine sample, the contractor may claim a maximum of 3 hours at the firm hourly rate. This fee shall only apply if the contractor scheduled a single collection. It will not apply when the contractor scheduled multiple collections for the same time period and at least one offender shows up. 1.3 Location of work: The Contractor must perf

title: RFSO -Coastal imaging, habitat classification, shoreline assessment in Canada
description: The Department of Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) has a requirement to establish a Standing Offer to provide professional services for the design, implementation, review, and maintenance of coastal imaging and habitat classification data and products for all Canadian coasts. The Contractor will use their expertise in coastal imaging, conducting aerial imaging and ground truthing surveys, and processing aerial imagery to produce open-source data products. The goal is to support DFO in shoreline classification, species, habitat and ecosystem vulnerability, and ocean protection. Specific goals include completing aerial imaging, stills, video, and ground truthing surveys, characterization and mapping of shoreline attributes, identification and characterization of biologically significant species and habitats, characterization of shoreline and nearshore species and habitats for wave exposure and oil residency indices, database creation and services, and publication of end products and reports. DFO will benefit from these services by efficiently collecting, processing, analyzing, and documenting data for the Ocean Protection Plan and spill response planning initiatives. Canada intend to establish one (1) Standing Offer (SO) to a qualified supplier who can provide the services to meet the general needs outlined in the Statement of Work Annex. The period of the Standing Offer will be from date of SO issuance until September 30, 2031. The Request for Standing Offers (RFSO) is to establish a National Individual Standing Offer for the requirement detailed in the RFSO, to the Identified Users across Canada, excluding locations within Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Quebec, and Labrador that are subject to Comprehensive Land Claims Agreements (CLCAs). Any requirement for deliveries to locations within CLCAs areas within Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Quebec, or Labrador will have to be treated as a separate procurement, outside of the resulting standing offers. The requirement is subject to World Trade Organization-Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-AGP), Canada - European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), and the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA).

REQUIREMENT The parking lot covered by this contract is the primary parking area for visitors and employees of the site. With an approximate surface area of 2,600 m² and approximately sixty parking spaces, it constitutes essential infrastructure for the accessibility and proper operation of the national historic site. The rehabilitation work must be carried out in a context where public safety, protection of heritage resources, environmental preservation, and the continuation of normal site operations remain priority considerations. title: APN_ONTARIO ARMOURIES SITE ENHANCEMENT PROGRAM VARIOUS ONTARIO LOCATIONS
description: Advance Procurement Notice CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT SERVICES FOR: ONTARIO ARMOURIES SITE ENHANCEMENT PROGRAM VARIOUS ONTARIO LOCATIONS (with Security Requirements) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity in Hamilton and other locations in Southern and Central Ontario. The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Description of the Project and Services This project will address infrastructure requirements to recapitalize Department of National Defence reserve and armoury infrastructure at multiple sites throughout Southern and Central Ontario. The delivery method for much of this project is anticipated to be Construction Management. The purpose of this project is to retain the services of a contractor to provide construction management services during the pre-construction and construction phases. The program is anticipated to include planned phased work packages implemented over a 7-10 year period while maintaining operations at the sites. Construction Management services are anticipated to support delivery of Track A (HMCS Star and CFRB Hamilton), are expected to support delivery of Track B (six armouries), and may be expanded in the future to include Track C (thirteen additional armouries). Major construction services are expected to include: Vertical infrastructure; construction of new facilities, recapitalization of existing facilities, and upgrades to building systems and components. Horizontal infrastructure; water distribution, wastewater collection, electrical distribution, communications systems, natural gas distribution, security infrastructure, site services, roads, parking areas and related civil works. The estimated construction cost is in the order of $100,000,000, consisting of approximately $60,000,000 for Track A and $40,000,000 for Track B. Additional future work associated with Track C may increase the overall program value by up to an additional $110,000,000. It is anticipated that this solicitation will be initiated in November 2026. This is conditional on receiving approval to proceed by the Department of National Defence (DND). Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants or contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice); Contract number 88064; and Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants or contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a consultant or contractor: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (Contract number listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and has submitted a proposal or a bid. DCC will  send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent or bidder regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent or bidder will need to promptly cooperate with CSP  to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Lucia Apted Coordinator, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada TTcontracting@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process  and does not provide any representations or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent or bidder agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the bidder or proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. title: Subscription licenses to BNEF Bloomberg
description: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED) supports informed decision-making on major industrial, economic development and clean technology initiatives. To fulfil this mandate, the Department requires reliable and up-to-date intelligence on global clean technology markets, investment flows, industrial trends, policy developments, emerging technologies and energy transition sectors. The Department has relied on BloombergNEF (BNEF) subscriptions to conduct research, monitor international market developments, assess investment opportunities, compare Canada's competitive position against other jurisdictions and support advice provided to senior government officials. BloombergNEF provides comprehensive market intelligence and analytical tools covering the clean technology and energy transition sectors that are not otherwise available through publicly accessible sources or other subscription services.

title: Independent Review of the Office of the DND/CAF Ombudsman
description: The Department of National Defence (DND) requires an independent third party to conduct a comprehensive review of the Office of the DND/Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) Ombudsman. The objective of this independent review is to examine the governance structure and authorities of the Office of the Ombudsman and benchmark the DND/CAF with the experience and practices of ombudsman functions from within the Government of Canada, other levels of government, and other similar democracies, including similar functions in allies’ militaries. This effort will help take forward Justice Fish’s Recommendation #103 to consider whether additional measures are needed to reinforce the Office of the Ombudsman’s independence and effectiveness.
